messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@peregrine-analytics.com>, Eric Lowe <eric.lowe@peregrine-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap — Roles, Timeline & Next Steps

Hi Aisha / Eric,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and a helpful view into Peregrine's production constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please confirm or correct any of the bullets below.

Top pain points we heard
- Latency variability across peak windows (real-time scoring SLA requirement: p99 < 300ms)
- Token-level cost of embeddings and batch-run reranking for nightly jobs
- Data residency concerns for some regulated data types (want VPC/Private option)

Stated goals
- Replace current onsite model inference with a managed inference path that keeps average latency under 200ms and reduces per-call cost by >=25%
- Pilot with 2 production flows (chat assist + nightly rerank) by end of Q3
- Define procurement and security checklist for a formal PoC

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft) — please review
- Milestone 1 (Week 1): Share technical artifacts (model manifest, sample traffic profile) — owner: Peregrine (Aisha) — target: 2027-07-03
- Milestone 2 (Week 2–3): Technical deep-dive + config recommendations (Connor) — target: 2027-07-14
- Milestone 3 (Week 4): PoC environment ready (Redwood Dedicated or Private) + smoke tests (Ben/Marissa) — target: 2027-07-28
- Milestone 4 (Week 6): Pilot evaluation and SLO signoff (all) — target: 2027-08-11

Open questions / asks from Peregrine
- Procurement contact and estimated SOW procurement timeline
- Any internal compliance docs we should prep (SOC-2 questionnaire is typical)

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP and a high-level infra diagram for your review.

Next steps (my ask)
1) Confirm Aisha / Eric and add procurement contact (Nicole?)
2) Confirm Champions: Technical (who will join the deep dive), Business (decision owner)
3) Pick two 60-minute slots for the technical deep-dive (suggested: July 7 or July 12 morning PST)

I'll update the MAP and circulate a versioned sheet after your confirmation.

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0148
